{
  "contents": "import axios from 'axios';\nimport { techPointModel, techCategoryModel } from '../models';\nimport { CreateTechPointDTO, UpdateTechPointDTO, Status, TechType, Priority } from '../types/database';\nimport { logger } from '../shared/lib/logger';\n\n/**\n * TPD2 同步服务\n * 从 TPD2 项目同步技术点数据到 todify3 数据库\n */\nexport class TPDSyncService {\n  private tpdApiBaseUrl: string;\n\n  constructor() {\n    // 从环境变量或配置获取 TPD2 API 地址\n    this.tpdApiBaseUrl = process.env.TPD_API_BASE_URL || 'http://localhost:3004/api/external/v1';\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 同步技术点数据\n   * 从 TPD2 获取所有技术点，并存储到 todify3 数据库（覆盖更新）\n   */\n  async syncTechPoints(): Promise&lt;{\n    success: boolean;\n    message: string;\n    stats: {\n      total: number;\n      created: number;\n      updated: number;\n      errors: number;\n    };\n  }&gt; {\n    const stats = {\n      total: 0,\n      created: 0,\n      updated: 0,\n      errors: 0,\n    };\n\n    try {\n      logger.info('开始同步 TPD2 技术点数据...');\n\n      // 分页获取所有技术点\n      let page = 1;\n      const pageSize = 100;\n      let hasMore = true;\n\n      while (hasMore) {\n        try {\n          // 从 TPD2 获取技术点列表\n          const response = await axios.get(&#96;${this.tpdApiBaseUrl}/tech-points&#96;, {\n            params: {\n              page,\n              pageSize,\n              orderBy: 'created_at',\n              orderDirection: 'ASC',\n            },\n            timeout: 30000,\n          });\n\n          if (response.data.code !== 200 || !response.data.data) {\n            logger.error('TPD2 API 返回错误:', response.data);\n            break;\n          }\n\n          const paginatedData = response.data.data;\n          const techPoints = paginatedData.data || [];\n\n          if (techPoints.length === 0) {\n            hasMore = false;\n            break;\n          }\n\n          stats.total += techPoints.length;\n\n          // 处理每个技术点\n          for (const tpdTechPoint of techPoints) {\n            try {\n              const result = await this.syncSingleTechPoint(tpdTechPoint);\n              if (result.created) {\n                stats.created++;\n              } else {\n                stats.updated++;\n              }\n            } catch (error) {\n              logger.error(&#96;同步技术点失败 (ID: ${tpdTechPoint.id}):&#96;, error);\n              stats.errors++;\n            }\n          }\n\n          // 检查是否还有更多数据\n          if (techPoints.length &lt; pageSize) {\n            hasMore = false;\n          } else {\n            page++;\n          }\n        } catch (error) {\n          logger.error(&#96;获取第 ${page} 页数据失败:&#96;, error);\n          stats.errors++;\n          hasMore = false;\n        }\n      }\n\n      logger.info('TPD2 技术点数据同步完成', stats);\n\n      return {\n        success: true,\n        message: &#96;同步完成：总计 ${stats.total} 条，新增 ${stats.created} 条，更新 ${stats.updated} 条，错误 ${stats.errors} 条&#96;,\n        stats,\n      };\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.error('同步技术点数据失败:', error);\n      return {\n        success: false,\n        message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '同步失败',\n        stats,\n      };\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 同步单个技术点\n   * @returns {Promise&lt;{created: boolean}&gt;} 返回是否为新创建\n   */\n  private async syncSingleTechPoint(tpdTechPoint: any): Promise&lt;{ created: boolean }&gt; {\n    try {\n      // 获取技术点详情（包含关联数据）\n      const detailResponse = await axios.get(\n        &#96;${this.tpdApiBaseUrl}/tech-points/${tpdTechPoint.id}&#96;,\n        {\n          params: {\n            includeAssociations: true,\n          },\n          timeout: 30000,\n        }\n      );\n\n      if (detailResponse.data.code !== 200 || !detailResponse.data.data) {\n        throw new Error('获取技术点详情失败');\n      }\n\n      const techPointDetail = detailResponse.data.data;\n\n      // 准备技术点数据\n      const techPointData: CreateTechPointDTO = {\n        name: techPointDetail.name,\n        description: techPointDetail.description || null,\n        category_id: techPointDetail.category_id || null,\n        parent_id: techPointDetail.parent_id || null,\n        level: techPointDetail.level || 1,\n        tech_type: this.mapTechType(techPointDetail.tech_type),\n        priority: this.mapPriority(techPointDetail.priority),\n        status: this.mapStatus(techPointDetail.status),\n        tags: techPointDetail.tags || null,\n        technical_details: techPointDetail.technical_details || null,\n        benefits: techPointDetail.benefits || null,\n        applications: techPointDetail.applications || null,\n        keywords: techPointDetail.keywords || null,\n        source_url: techPointDetail.source_url || null,\n        created_by: techPointDetail.created_by || null,\n      };\n\n      // 检查技术点是否已存在（通过名称查找，因为 ID 可能不同）\n      // 首先尝试通过 ID 查找\n      let existing = await techPointModel.findById(techPointDetail.id);\n      \n      // 如果通过 ID 找不到，尝试通过名称查找\n      if (!existing) {\n        const allTechPoints = await techPointModel.findAll({ limit: 10000 });\n        existing = allTechPoints.data.find((tp: any) =&gt; tp.name === techPointDetail.name);\n      }\n\n      let created = false;\n      if (existing) {\n        // 更新现有技术点\n        const updateData: UpdateTechPointDTO = techPointData;\n        await techPointModel.update(existing.id, updateData);\n        created = false;\n      } else {\n        // 创建新技术点\n        await techPointModel.create(techPointData);\n        created = true;\n      }\n\n      // 同步关联的车型（如果有）\n      if (techPointDetail.carModels &amp;&amp; Array.isArray(techPointDetail.carModels)) {\n        // 这里可以添加同步车型关联的逻辑\n        // 由于车型关联可能涉及复杂的业务逻辑，暂时跳过\n        logger.debug(&#96;技术点 ${techPointDetail.id} 关联了 ${techPointDetail.carModels.length} 个车型&#96;);\n      }\n\n      return { created };\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.error(&#96;同步技术点 ${tpdTechPoint.id} 失败:&#96;, error);\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 映射技术点类型\n   */\n  private mapTechType(tpdType: string): TechType {\n    const typeMap: Record&lt;string, TechType&gt; = {\n      feature: TechType.FEATURE,\n      technology: TechType.TECHNOLOGY,\n      innovation: TechType.INNOVATION,\n      improvement: TechType.IMPROVEMENT,\n    };\n    return typeMap[tpdType] || TechType.FEATURE;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 映射优先级\n   */\n  private mapPriority(tpdPriority: string): Priority {\n    const priorityMap: Record&lt;string, Priority&gt; = {\n      low: Priority.LOW,\n      medium: Priority.MEDIUM,\n      high: Priority.HIGH,\n      critical: Priority.CRITICAL,\n    };\n    return priorityMap[tpdPriority] || Priority.MEDIUM;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 映射状态\n   */\n  private mapStatus(tpdStatus: string): Status {\n    const statusMap: Record&lt;string, Status&gt; = {\n      active: Status.ACTIVE,\n      inactive: Status.INACTIVE,\n      draft: Status.DRAFT,\n      archived: Status.ARCHIVED,\n    };\n    return statusMap[tpdStatus] || Status.DRAFT;\n  }\n}\n\n// 导出单例实例\nexport const tpdSyncService = new TPDSyncService();\n\n",
  "totalLinesInFile": 241
}

{\n    return new Promise((resolve, reject) =&gt; {\n      // 确保数据目录存在\n      const dir = path.dirname(this.dbPath);\n      if (!fs.existsSync(dir)) {\n        fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });\n      }\n\n      this.db = new sqlite3.Database(this.dbPath, (err) =&gt; {\n    if (!this.db) {\n      throw new Error('数据库未连接');\n    }\n\n    console.log('SQLiteManager.query - SQL:', sql);\n    console.log('SQLiteManager.query - Params:', params);\n\n    return new Promise((resolve, reject) =&gt; 根据您的需求，我对项目进行了分析并制定了重新规划方案。

当前项目使用 **Node.js + Express + TypeScript**，数据库支持 **SQLite/PostgreSQL**（无 ORM，使用原生 SQL 封装）。现有的 `TechPoint` 架构采用了关系型设计（关联表），为了实现“一张表管理”并支持高效的 TPD2 同步，建议采用 **单表 + JSON 字段** 的设计模式。

以下是详细的技术规划：

### 1. 核心设计思路：单表结构化管理

将原本分散在 `tech_point_car_models`（车型关联）和各类资源表（`tech_packaging_materials` 等）的数据，直接聚合到 `tech_points` 表的 JSON 字段中。

**优势：**
*   **管理便捷**：所有数据在一个 Entity 中，CRUD 操作原子化。
*   **同步高效**：TPD2 API 返回的通常是嵌套 JSON，直接存入本地 JSON 字段无需复杂的关联表拆解逻辑。
*   **结构灵活**：方便后续扩展字段。

### 2. 数据库 Schema 变更规划

我们需要修改 `tech_points` 表，新增以下字段：

| 字段名 | 类型 | 描述 |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **`tpd_id`** | String/Int | **关键**：记录 TPD2 源项目的 ID，用于后续的双向同步锚点，替代不稳定的“按名称匹配”。 |
| **`car_models_info`** | JSON | 存储车型列表。结构：`[{ id, name, brand, launch_date, status }, ...]` |
| **`resources_info`** | JSON | 存储资源列表。结构：`[{ type: 'pdf', name, url }, { type: 'link', name, url }]` |
| **`knowledge_info`** | JSON | (整合现有) 存储知识点详情，如 `technical_details` 等。 |

*(现有字段 `name`, `description`, `category_id`, `status` 保持不变)*

### 3. TPD2 同步逻辑重构 (`TPDSyncService`)

当前同步逻辑较为分散且跳过了车型数据。新逻辑如下：

1.  **获取**：调用 TPD2 通稿 API 获取全量/分页数据。
2.  **映射**：
    *   将 API 返回的 `car_models` 数组直接序列化存入 `car_models_info`。
    *   将 API 返回的各类附件/链接聚合后序列化存入 `resources_info`。
    *   **匹配策略**：优先使用 `tpd_id` 匹配；如果不存在，再回退到 `name` 匹配（并更新 `tpd_id`）。
3.  **持久化**：直接 Update/Insert 单条 `tech_point` 记录。

### 4. 实施计划 (TODO)

我已为您创建了任务列表，我们将按以下步骤执行：

1.  **数据库迁移**：编写 SQL 脚本，为 `tech_points` 表添加 `tpd_id`, `car_models_info`, `resources_info` 字段。
2.  **后端模型升级**：修改 `backend/src/models/TechPoint.ts`，增加对新字段的读写支持。
3.  **同步服务重写**：修改 `backend/src/services/tpdSyncService.ts`，实现新的“单表直存”逻辑。
4.  **API 验证**：验证同步功能是否能完整保存 TPD2 的数据。

如果您同意这个方案，我将从**第一步（数据库变更）**开始执行。请确认。

        "contents": "CREATE TABLE tech_points (\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\n    name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL COMMENT '技术点名称',\n    description TEXT COMMENT '技术点描述',\n    tech_category_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '技术分类ID',\n    parent_id BIGINT COMMENT '父技术点ID（支持子技术点）',\n    technical_details JSON COMMENT '技术详情（JSON格式）',\n    difficulty_level ENUM('初级', '中级', '高级', '专家') DEFAULT '中级' COMMENT '技术难度',\n    maturity_level ENUM('概念', '开发中', '测试', '量产', '成熟') DEFAULT '开发中' COMMENT '技术成熟度',\n    priority INT DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '优先级',\n    tags JSON COMMENT '标签（JSON数组）',\n    is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE COMMENT '是否启用',\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    INDEX idx_category (tech_category_id),\n    INDEX idx_parent (parent_id),\n    INDEX idx_priority (priority),\n    INDEX idx_difficulty (difficulty_level),\n    INDEX idx_maturity (maturity_level),\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_category_id) REFERENCES tech_categories(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,\n    FOREIGN KEY (parent_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE SET NULL\n);-- 4. 技术点与车型关联表\nCREATE TABLE tech_point_car_models (\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\n    tech_point_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '技术点ID',",

        "contents": ");-- 11. 演讲稿与技术点关联表\nCREATE TABLE speech_tech_points (\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\n    speech_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '演讲稿ID',\n    tech_point_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '技术点ID',\n    presentation_order INT COMMENT '演讲顺序',\n    emphasis_level ENUM('重点强调', '详细介绍', '简要提及') DEFAULT '详细介绍' COMMENT '强调程度',\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    UNIQUE KEY uk_speech_tech (speech_id, tech_point_id),\n    INDEX idx_speech (speech_id),\n    INDEX idx_tech_point (tech_point_id),\n    INDEX idx_order (presentation_order),\n    FOREIGN KEY (speech_id) REFERENCES tech_speeches(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\n);\n\n-- 插入示例数据\n-- 技术分类示例数据\nINSERT INTO tech_categories (name, description, sort_order) VALUES\n('动力系统', '发动机、电机、传动系统等相关技术', 1),\n('智能驾驶', '自动驾驶、辅助驾驶相关技术', 2),\n('车联网', '车载通信、物联网技术', 3),\n('新能源', '电池、充电、能源管理技术', 4),\n('安全技术', '主动安全、被动安全技术', 5);\n\n-- 车型车系示例数据\nINSERT INTO car_models (brand, series, model, year_start, year_end) VALUES\n('比亚迪', '汉', '汉EV', 2020, NULL),\n('比亚迪', '汉', '汉DM', 2020, NULL),\n('比亚迪', '唐', '唐EV', 2018, NULL),\n('比亚迪', '宋', '宋PLUS EV', 2021, NULL),\n('特斯拉', 'Model 3', 'Model 3', 2019, NULL);\n\n-- 技术点示例数据\nINSERT INTO tech_points (name, description, tech_category_id, difficulty_level, maturity_level, priority) VALUES\n('刀片电池技术', '磷酸铁锂刀片电池，提高安全性和能量密度', 4, '高级', '量产', 10),\n('DM-i超级混动', '插电式混合动力系统，兼顾性能和经济性', 1, '高级', '量产', 9),\n('DiPilot智能驾驶', 'L2+级别智能驾驶辅助系统', 2, '专家', '测试', 8),\n('DiLink智能网联', '车机互联系统，支持OTA升级', 3, '中级', '成熟', 7);\n\n-- 技术点与车型关联示例数据",

        "contents": "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_speeches (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,\n    content TEXT NOT NULL,\n    speech_type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,\n    duration_minutes INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    target_audience VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,\n    event_name VARCHAR(255),\n    event_date DATE,\n    speaker_notes TEXT,\n    slides_outline TEXT, -- JSON格式存储幻灯片大纲\n    status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft',\n    generation_params TEXT, -- JSON格式存储生成参数\n    dify_task_id VARCHAR(255),\n    created_by VARCHAR(255),\n    reviewed_by VARCHAR(255),\n    delivered_by VARCHAR(255),\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\n-- 推广策略与技术点关联表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS promotion_tech_points (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    promotion_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    tech_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    weight DECIMAL(3,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1.0,\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    FOREIGN KEY (promotion_id) REFERENCES tech_promotion_strategies(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    UNIQUE(promotion_id, tech_point_id)\n);\n\n-- 通稿与技术点关联表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS press_tech_points (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    press_release_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    tech_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    weight DECIMAL(3,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1.0,\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    FOREIGN KEY (press_release_id) REFERENCES tech_press_releases(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    UNIQUE(press_release_id, tech_point_id)\n);\n\n-- 演讲稿与技术点关联表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS speech_tech_points (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    speech_id INTEGER NOT NULL,",

        "contents": "-- Todify3 数据库创建脚本\n-- 创建数据库\nCREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS todify3 CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci;\nUSE todify3;\n\n-- 1. 技术分类表\nCREATE TABLE tech_categories (\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\n    name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT '分类名称',\n    description TEXT COMMENT '分类描述',\n    parent_id BIGINT COMMENT '父分类ID',\n    sort_order INT DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '排序',\n    is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE COMMENT '是否启用',\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    INDEX idx_parent_id (parent_id),\n    INDEX idx_sort_order (sort_order),\n    FOREIGN KEY (parent_id) REFERENCES tech_categories(id) ON DELETE SET NULL\n);\n\n-- 2. 车型车系表\nCREATE TABLE car_models (\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\n    brand VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL COMMENT '品牌',\n    series VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT '车系',\n    model VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT '车型',\n    year_start INT COMMENT '起始年份',\n    year_end INT COMMENT '结束年份',\n    description TEXT COMMENT '描述',\n    is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE COMMENT '是否启用',\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    INDEX idx_brand_series (brand, series),\n    INDEX idx_model (model),\n    INDEX idx_year (year_start, year_end)\n);\n\n-- 3. 技术点表\nCREATE TABLE tech_points (\n    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,",

        "contents": "async function createKnowledgePointsTable(): Promise&lt;void&gt; {\n\n\n    if (tableExists) {\n      console.log('✅ knowledge_points 表已存在');\n      \n      // 检查是否有 tech_point_id 字段\n      let hasTechPointId = false;\n      if (dbType === 'sqlite') {\n        const tableInfo = await db.query('PRAGMA table_info(knowledge_points)');\n        const columns = Array.isArray(tableInfo) ? tableInfo : [tableInfo];\n        hasTechPointId = columns.some((col: any) =&gt; col.name === 'tech_point_id');\n      } else {\n        const checkResult = await db.query(&#96;\n          SELECT EXISTS (\n            SELECT FROM information_schema.columns \n            WHERE table_schema = 'public' \n            AND table_name = 'knowledge_points' \n            AND column_name = 'tech_point_id'\n          )\n        &#96;);\n        hasTechPointId = checkResult[0]?.exists === true;\n      }\n\n      if (!hasTechPointId) {\n        console.log('📝 添加 tech_point_id 字段...');\n        await db.query(&#96;\n          ALTER TABLE knowledge_points \n          ADD COLUMN tech_point_id INTEGER\n        &#96;);\n        console.log('✅ 已添加 tech_point_id 字段');\n      }\n\n      // 检查其他必要字段\n      const requiredFields = [\n        { name: 'knowledge_type', type: 'TEXT', default: \"'concept'\" },\n        { name: 'difficulty_level', type: 'TEXT', default: \"'medium'\" },\n        { name: 'prerequisites', type: 'TEXT', default: 'NULL' },\n        { name: 'learning_objectives', type: 'TEXT', default: 'NULL' },\n        { name: 'examples', type: 'TEXT', default: 'NULL' },\n        { name: 'references', type: 'TEXT', default: 'NULL' },\n      ];\n\n      for (const field of requiredFields)\n}",

        "contents": "-- 技术点与知识点关联表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_point_knowledge_points (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    tech_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    knowledge_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    relation_type TEXT DEFAULT 'related' CHECK (relation_type IN ('reference', 'support', 'related', 'example')),\n    relevance_score REAL,\n    notes TEXT,\n    created_by INTEGER,\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    FOREIGN KEY (knowledge_point_id) REFERENCES knowledge_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    UNIQUE(tech_point_id, knowledge_point_id)\n);\n\n-- 知识点收藏表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS knowledge_point_favorites (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    knowledge_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    user_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    FOREIGN KEY (knowledge_point_id) REFERENCES knowledge_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    UNIQUE(user_id, knowledge_point_id)\n);\n\n-- 技术包装材料表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_packaging_materials (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    tech_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,\n    content TEXT NOT NULL,\n    material_type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,\n    target_audience VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,\n    language VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'zh',\n    status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft',\n    generation_params TEXT, -- JSON格式存储生成参数\n    dify_task_id VARCHAR(255),\n    created_by VARCHAR(255),\n    reviewed_by VARCHAR(255),\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\n);\n\n-- 技术推广策略表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_promotion_strategies (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,",

        "contents": "async function addTechPointIdToKnowledgePoints(): Promise&lt;void&gt; {\n\n\n    // 添加字段\n    if (dbType === 'sqlite') {\n      // SQLite 不支持直接添加 NOT NULL 字段，先添加可空字段\n      await db.query(&#96;\n        ALTER TABLE knowledge_points \n        ADD COLUMN tech_point_id INTEGER\n      &#96;);\n      \n      // 添加外键约束（SQLite 需要重新创建表）\n      console.log('⚠️  SQLite 需要手动添加外键约束');\n      console.log('   建议使用以下 SQL 重新创建表或手动添加外键');\n    } else {\n      // PostgreSQL\n      await db.query(&#96;\n        ALTER TABLE knowledge_points \n        ADD COLUMN tech_point_id INTEGER,\n        ADD CONSTRAINT fk_knowledge_points_tech_point \n        FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\n      &#96;);\n    }\n\n    // 添加索引\n    try {\n      await db.query(&#96;\n        CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_knowledge_points_tech_point_id \n        ON knowledge_points(tech_point_id)\n      &#96;);\n      console.log('✅ 已添加索引');\n    } catch (error: any) {\n      console.warn('⚠️  添加索引失败:', error.message);\n    }\n\n    // 添加其他可能缺失的字段（根据 KnowledgePointService 需要的字段）\n    const requiredFields = [\n      { name: 'knowledge_type', type: 'TEXT', default: \"'concept'\" },\n      { name: 'difficulty_level', type: 'TEXT', default: \"'medium'\" },\n      { name: 'prerequisites', type: 'TEXT', default: 'NULL' },\n      { name: 'learning_objectives', type: 'TEXT', default: 'NULL' },\n      { name: 'examples', type: 'TEXT', default: 'NULL' },\n      { name: 'references', type: 'TEXT', default: 'NULL' },\n    ];\n\n    for (const field of requiredFields)\n}",

        "contents": "/**\n * 创建技术分类和技术点表\n */\nasync function createTechTables(): Promise&lt;void&gt; {\n  if (await tableExists('tech_categories')) {\n    console.log('✅ tech_categories 表已存在');\n  } else {\n    const sql = &#96;\n      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_categories (\n        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n        name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,\n        description TEXT,\n        parent_id INTEGER,\n        level INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,\n        sort_order INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,\n        status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',\n        created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n        updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n        FOREIGN KEY (parent_id) REFERENCES tech_categories(id) ON DELETE SET NULL\n      );\n      \n      CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_tech_categories_parent_id ON tech_categories(parent_id);\n      CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_tech_categories_status ON tech_categories(status);\n    &#96;;\n    await executeSQL(sql);\n    console.log('✅ tech_categories 表创建成功');\n  }\n\n  if (await tableExists('tech_points'))\n}",

        "contents": "| category | TEXT | 车型类别 |\n| launch_year | INTEGER | 上市年份 |\n| end_year | INTEGER | 停产年份 |\n| description | TEXT | 描述 |\n| status | TEXT | 状态 |\n| created_at | DATETIME | 创建时间 |\n| updated_at | DATETIME | 更新时间 |\n\n#### 2.1.3 车系表 (car_series)\n\n存储车系信息，关联车型。\n\n#### 2.1.4 技术分类表 (tech_categories)\n\n存储技术分类，支持层级结构。\n\n| 字段名 | 类型 | 说明 |\n|--------|------|------|\n| id | INTEGER | 主键，自增 |\n| name | VARCHAR(255) | 分类名称 |\n| description | TEXT | 描述 |\n| parent_id | INTEGER | 父分类ID（外键） |\n| level | INTEGER | 层级（默认1） |\n| sort_order | INTEGER | 排序 |\n| status | VARCHAR(50) | 状态 |\n| created_at | DATETIME | 创建时间 |\n| updated_at | DATETIME | 更新时间 |\n\n#### 2.1.5 技术点表 (tech_points)\n\n存储技术点信息，支持父子关系。\n\n| 字段名 | 类型 | 说明 |\n|--------|------|------|\n| id | INTEGER | 主键，自增 |\n| name | VARCHAR(255) | 技术点名称 |\n| description | TEXT | 描述 |\n| category_id | INTEGER | 外键，关联tech_categories.id |\n| parent_id | INTEGER | 父技术点ID（外键） |\n| level | INTEGER | 层级 |\n| tech_type | VARCHAR(50) | 技术类型 |\n| priority | VARCHAR(50) | 优先级 |\n| status | VARCHAR(50) | 状态 |\n| tags | TEXT | JSON数组格式的标签 |\n| technical_details | TEXT | JSON格式的技术细节 |\n| benefits | TEXT | JSON数组格式的优势 |\n| applications | TEXT | JSON数组格式的应用场景 |\n| keywords | TEXT | JSON数组格式的关键词 |\n| source_url | VARCHAR(500) | 来源URL |\n| created_by | VARCHAR(255) | 创建者 |\n| created_at | DATETIME | 创建时间 |\n| updated_at | DATETIME | 更新时间 |\n\n### 2.2 第二层：关联关系层\n\n#### 2.2.1 技术点与车型关联表 (tech_point_car_models)\n\n多对多关系表，关联技术点和车型。\n\n| 字段名 | 类型 | 说明 |\n|--------|------|------|\n| id | INTEGER | 主键，自增 |\n| tech_point_id | INTEGER | 外键，关联tech_points.id |\n| car_model_id | INTEGER | 外键，关联car_models.id |",

        "contents": "export class TechPointModel {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 创建技术点\n   */\n  async create(data: CreateTechPointDTO): Promise&lt;TechPoint&gt; {\n    const dbType = this.db.getType();\n    \n    const values = [\n      data.name,\n      data.description || null,\n      data.category_id || null,\n      data.parent_id || null,\n      data.level || 1,\n      data.tech_type || TechType.FEATURE,\n      data.priority || Priority.MEDIUM,\n      data.status || Status.DRAFT,\n      data.tags ? JSON.stringify(data.tags) : null,\n      data.technical_details ? JSON.stringify(data.technical_details) : null,\n      data.benefits ? JSON.stringify(data.benefits) : null,\n      data.applications ? JSON.stringify(data.applications) : null,\n      data.keywords ? JSON.stringify(data.keywords) : null,\n      data.source_url || null,\n      data.created_by || null\n    ];\n\n    if (dbType === 'sqlite') {\n      // SQLite 不支持 RETURNING，需要先插入再查询\n      const sql = &#96;\n        INSERT INTO tech_points (\n          name, description, category_id, parent_id, level, tech_type, \n          priority, status, tags, technical_details, benefits, applications, \n          keywords, source_url, created_by\n        )\n        VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\n      &#96;;\n      const result = await this.db.query(sql, values);\n      const insertId = result.lastID || result.insertId;\n      if (!insertId) {\n        throw new Error('Failed to create tech point: no ID returned');\n      }\n      const created = await this.findById(insertId);\n      if (!created) {\n        throw new Error('Failed to retrieve created tech point');\n      }\n      return created;\n    } else {\n      // PostgreSQL 支持 RETURNING\n      const sql = &#96;\n        INSERT INTO tech_points (\n          name, description, category_id, parent_id, level, tech_type, \n          priority, status, tags, technical_details, benefits, applications, \n          keywords, source_url, created_by\n        )\n        VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\n        RETURNING *\n      &#96;;\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "/**\n * 主函数：创建所有缺失的表\n */\nasync function createMissingTables() {\n  try {\n    console.log('═══════════════════════════════════════════');\n    console.log('   创建缺失的数据库表');\n    console.log('═══════════════════════════════════════════');\n    console.log('');\n\n    await db.connect();\n    console.log('✅ 数据库连接成功\\n');\n\n    // 按顺序创建表（考虑外键依赖）\n    console.log('📝 开始创建缺失的表...\\n');\n\n    // 1. 品牌表（无依赖）\n    await createBrandsTable();\n\n    // 2. 车型和车系表（依赖brands）\n    await createCarTables();\n\n    // 3. 技术分类和技术点表（无外部依赖）\n    await createTechTables();\n\n    // 4. 页面工具配置表（无依赖）\n    await createPageToolConfigTable();\n\n    // 5. 工作流统计表（无依赖）\n    await createWorkflowStatsTables();\n\n    console.log('\\n🎉 所有缺失的表创建完成！');\n\n    // 验证创建结果\n    console.log('\\n📊 验证创建结果：');\n    const tablesToCheck = [\n      'brands',\n      'car_models',\n      'car_series',\n      'tech_categories',\n      'tech_points',\n      'page_tool_configs',\n      'workflow_stats_summary',\n    ];\n\n    for (const table of tablesToCheck) {\n      const exists = await tableExists(table);\n      if (exists) {\n        const count = await db.query(&#96;SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM ${table}&#96;) as any[];\n        const recordCount = Array.isArray(count) &amp;&amp; count.length &gt; 0 ? count[0].count : 0;\n        console.log(&#96;   ✅ ${table}: 存在 (${recordCount} 条记录)&#96;);\n      } else {\n        console.log(&#96;   ❌ ${table}: 不存在&#96;);\n      }\n    }\n\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('❌ 创建表失败:', error);\n    throw error;\n  } finally {\n    await db.close();\n  }\n}\n\n// 如果直接运行此脚本\nif (require.main === module)",

AND car_model_id = ?\n    &#96;;\n    const existing = await this.db.query(existingSql, [techPointId, carModelId]);\n    \n    if (existing.length &gt; 0) {\n      throw new Error('该车型已与此技术点关联');\n    }\n\n    const sql = &#96;\n      INSERT INTO tech_point_car_models (\n        tech_point_id, car_model_id, application_status, \n        implementation_date, notes, created_at\n      )\n      VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, datetime('now'))\n      RETURNING *\n    &#96;;\n    \n    const values = [\n      techPointId,\n      carModelId,\n      applicationStatus || 'planned',\n      implementationDate || null,\n      notes || null\n    ];\n    \n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, values);\n    return result[0];\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 取消车型与技术点的关联\n   */\n  async disassociateCarModel(techPointId: number, carModelId: number): Promise&lt;boolean&gt; {\n    \n  }\n}",

        "contents": "async function importTechPoint(tpdTechPoint: TPD2TechPoint): Promise&lt;{\n  success: boolean;\n  techPointId?: number;\n  message: string;\n}&gt; {\n {\n      for (const carModelData of tpdTechPoint.associated_car_models) {\n        try {\n          // 如果已有car_model_id，直接使用\n          let carModelId: number;\n          if (carModelData.car_model_id) {\n            const existingCarModel = await carModelModel.findById(carModelData.car_model_id);\n            if (existingCarModel) {\n              carModelId = existingCarModel.id;\n            } else {\n              // 如果ID不存在，通过品牌和名称查找或创建\n              carModelId = await findOrCreateCarModel(\n                carModelData.brand,\n                carModelData.name,\n                carModelData.type\n              );\n            }\n          } else {\n            // 通过品牌和名称查找或创建\n            carModelId = await findOrCreateCarModel(\n              carModelData.brand,\n              carModelData.name,\n              carModelData.type\n            );\n          }\n\n          // 关联车型到技术点\n          try {\n            await techPointModel.associateCarModel(\n              techPointId,\n              carModelId,\n              'planned', // 默认状态\n              null,\n              carModelData.notes || carModelData.relationship || null\n            );\n            console.log(&#96;    ✅ 关联车型: ${carModelData.brand} ${carModelData.name}&#96;);\n          } catch (error: any) {\n            // 如果已存在关联，忽略错误\n            if (!error.message?.includes('已关联') &amp;&amp; !error.message?.includes('UNIQUE')) {\n              console.warn(&#96;    ⚠️  关联车型失败: ${carModelData.brand} ${carModelData.name} - ${error.message}&#96;);\n            }\n          }\n        } catch (error: any) {\n          console.warn(&#96;    ⚠️  处理车型失败: ${carModelData.name} - ${error.message}&#96;);\n        }\n      }\n    }\n\n    // 9. 处理技术知识点（创建独立的知识点记录）\n    const knowledgePointService = new KnowledgePointService();\n    let knowledgePointCount = 0;\n\n    // 技术原理\n    if\n}",

JSON.stringify(data.tags) : null,\n      data.technical_details ? JSON.stringify(data.technical_details) : null,\n      data.benefits ? JSON.stringify(data.benefits) : null,\n      data.applications ? JSON.stringify(data.applications) : null,\n      data.keywords ? JSON.stringify(data.keywords) : null,\n      data.source_url || null,\n      data.created_by || null\n    ];\n\n    if (dbType === 'sqlite') {\n      // SQLite 不支持 RETURNING，需要先插入再查询\n      const sql = &#96;\n        INSERT INTO tech_points (\n          name, description, category_id, parent_id, level, tech_type, \n          priority, status, tags, technical_details, benefits, applications, \n          keywords, source_url, created_by\n        )\n        VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\n      &#96;;\n      const result = await this.db.query(sql, values);\n      const insertId = result.lastID || result.insertId;\n      if (!insertId) {\n        throw new Error('Failed to create tech point: no ID returned');\n      }\n      const created = await this.findById(insertId);\n      if (!created) {\n        throw new Error('Failed to retrieve created tech point');\n      }\n      return created;\n    } else {\n      // PostgreSQL 支持 RETURNING\n      const sql = &#96;\n        INSERT INTO tech_points (\n          name, description, category_id, parent_id, level, tech_type, \n          priority, status, tags, technical_details, benefits, applications, \n          keywords, source_url, created_by\n        )\n        VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\n        RETURNING *\n      &#96;;\n  }\n}",

        },
        "contents": "export class TechPointModel {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 更新技术点\n   */\n  async update(id: number, data: UpdateTechPointDTO): Promise&lt;TechPoint | null&gt; {\n    const fields: string[] = [];\n    const values: any[] = [];\n\n    Object.entries(data).forEach(([key, value]) =&gt; {\n      if (value !== undefined) {\n        if (['tags', 'technical_details', 'benefits', 'applications', 'keywords'].includes(key)) {\n          fields.push(&#96;${key} = ?&#96;);\n          values.push(JSON.stringify(value));\n        } else {\n          fields.push(&#96;${key} = ?&#96;);\n          values.push(value);\n        }\n      }\n    });\n\n    if (fields.length === 0) {\n      return this.findById(id);\n    }\n\n    values.push(id);\n    \n    const sql = &#96;\n      UPDATE tech_points \n      SET ${fields.join(', ')}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n      WHERE id = ?\n      RETURNING *\n    &#96;;\n\n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, values);\n    return result.length &gt; 0 ? this.parseJsonFields(result[0]) as TechPoint : null;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 删除技术点（软删除）\n   */\n  async delete(id: number): Promise&lt;boolean&gt; {\n    // 检查是否有子技术点\n    const children = await this.findByParentId(id);\n  }\n}",
        "signatures": {

                "line": 13,
                "column": 1
              },

        "contents": "export class TechPointModel {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 获取技术点关联的车型\n   */\n  async getAssociatedCarModels(techPointId: number): Promise&lt;any[]&gt; {\n    try {\n    const sql = &#96;\n        SELECT \n          cm.*,\n          b.id as brand_id_ref,\n          b.name as brand_name,\n          b.name_en as brand_name_en,\n          tcm.application_status, \n          tcm.implementation_date, \n          tcm.notes\n      FROM car_models cm\n        LEFT JOIN brands b ON cm.brand_id = b.id\n      JOIN tech_point_car_models tcm ON cm.id = tcm.car_model_id\n      WHERE tcm.tech_point_id = ?\n        ORDER BY COALESCE(b.name, ''), cm.name\n    &#96;;\n    \n      const result = await this.db.query(sql, [techPointId]);\n      const carModels = Array.isArray(result) ? result : [];\n      \n      // 调试日志：检查返回的数据\n      if (carModels.length &gt; 0) {\n        console.log(&#96;[TechPointModel] 获取技术点 ${techPointId} 的关联车型:&#96;, \n          carModels.map((cm: any) =&gt; ({\n            id: cm.id,\n            name: cm.name,\n            brand_id: cm.brand_id,\n            brand_name: cm.brand_name,\n            brand_id_ref: cm.brand_id_ref\n          }))\n        );\n      }\n      \n      return carModels;\n    } catch (error: any) {\n      console.error('获取关联车型失败:', error.message);\n      // 如果表不存在，返回空数组\n      if (error.message?.includes('no such table')) {\n        return [];\n      }\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 关联车型到技术点\n   */\n  async associateCarModel(\n    techPointId: number, \n    carModelId: number, \n    applicationStatus?: string,\n    implementationDate?: string,\n    notes?: string\n  ): Promise&lt;any&gt; {\n    \n  }\n}",

        "contents": "-- 技术点与车型关联表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_point_car_models (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    tech_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    car_model_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    application_status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'planned',\n    implementation_date DATE,\n    notes TEXT,\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    FOREIGN KEY (tech_point_id) REFERENCES tech_points(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    FOREIGN KEY (car_model_id) REFERENCES car_models(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    UNIQUE(tech_point_id, car_model_id)\n);\n\n-- ==============================================\n-- 第三层：AI内容生成层\n-- ==============================================\n\n-- 知识点表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS knowledge_points (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    title TEXT NOT NULL,\n    content TEXT NOT NULL,\n    source_query TEXT,\n    source_url TEXT,\n    source_type TEXT DEFAULT 'ai_search' CHECK (source_type IN ('ai_search', 'manual', 'import')),\n    metadata TEXT, -- JSON字符串格式\n    tags TEXT, -- JSON字符串格式\n    relevance_score REAL,\n    status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'archived', 'deleted')),\n    dify_task_id TEXT,\n    ai_search_session_id TEXT,\n    created_by INTEGER,\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\n-- 技术点与知识点关联表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tech_point_knowledge_points (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    tech_point_id INTEGER NOT NULL,",

tp.name === techPointDetail.name);\n      }\n\n      let created = false;\n      if (existing) {\n        // 更新现有技术点\n        const updateData: UpdateTechPointDTO = techPointData;\n        await techPointModel.update(existing.id, updateData);\n        created = false;\n      } else {\n        // 创建新技术点\n        await techPointModel.create(techPointData);\n        created = true;\n      }\n\n      // 同步关联的车型（如果有）\n      if (techPointDetail.carModels &amp;&amp; {
  "contents": "import axios from 'axios';\nimport { techPointModel, techCategoryModel } from '../models';\nimport { CreateTechPointDTO, UpdateTechPointDTO, Status, TechType, Priority } from '../types/database';\nimport { logger } from '../shared/lib/logger';\n\n/**\n * TPD2 同步服务\n * 从 TPD2 项目同步技术点数据到 todify3 数据库\n */\nexport class TPDSyncService {\n  private tpdApiBaseUrl: string;\n\n  constructor() {\n    // 从环境变量或配置获取 TPD2 API 地址\n    this.tpdApiBaseUrl = process.env.TPD_API_BASE_URL || 'http://localhost:3004/api/external/v1';\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 同步技术点数据\n   * 从 TPD2 获取所有技术点，并存储到 todify3 数据库（覆盖更新）\n   */\n  async syncTechPoints(): Promise&lt;{\n    success: boolean;\n    message: string;\n    stats: {\n      total: number;\n      created: number;\n      updated: number;\n      errors: number;\n    };\n  }&gt; {\n    const stats = {\n      total: 0,\n      created: 0,\n      updated: 0,\n      errors: 0,\n    };\n\n    try {\n      logger.info('开始同步 TPD2 技术点数据...');\n\n      // 分页获取所有技术点\n      let page = 1;\n      const pageSize = 100;\n      let hasMore = true;\n\n      while (hasMore) {\n        try {\n          // 从 TPD2 获取技术点列表\n          const response = await axios.get(&#96;${this.tpdApiBaseUrl}/tech-points&#96;, {\n            params: {\n              page,\n              pageSize,\n              orderBy: 'created_at',\n              orderDirection: 'ASC',\n            },\n            timeout: 30000,\n          });\n\n          if (response.data.code !== 200 || !response.data.data) {\n            logger.error('TPD2 API 返回错误:', response.data);\n            break;\n          }\n\n          const paginatedData = response.data.data;\n          const techPoints = paginatedData.data || [];\n\n          if (techPoints.length === 0) {\n            hasMore = false;\n            break;\n          }\n\n          stats.total += techPoints.length;\n\n          // 处理每个技术点\n          for (const tpdTechPoint of techPoints) {\n            try {\n              const result = await this.syncSingleTechPoint(tpdTechPoint);\n              if (result.created) {\n                stats.created++;\n              } else {\n                stats.updated++;\n              }\n            } catch (error) {\n              logger.error(&#96;同步技术点失败 (ID: ${tpdTechPoint.id}):&#96;, error);\n              stats.errors++;\n            }\n          }\n\n          // 检查是否还有更多数据\n          if (techPoints.length &lt; pageSize) {\n            hasMore = false;\n          } else {\n            page++;\n          }\n        } catch (error) {\n          logger.error(&#96;获取第 ${page} 页数据失败:&#96;, error);\n          stats.errors++;\n          hasMore = false;\n        }\n      }\n\n      logger.info('TPD2 技术点数据同步完成', stats);\n\n      return {\n        success: true,\n        message: &#96;同步完成：总计 ${stats.total} 条，新增 ${stats.created} 条，更新 ${stats.updated} 条，错误 ${stats.errors} 条&#96;,\n        stats,\n      };\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.error('同步技术点数据失败:', error);\n      return {\n        success: false,\n        message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '同步失败',\n        stats,\n      };\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 同步单个技术点\n   * @returns {Promise&lt;{created: boolean}&gt;} 返回是否为新创建\n   */\n  private async syncSingleTechPoint(tpdTechPoint: any): Promise&lt;{ created: boolean }&gt; {\n    try {\n      // 获取技术点详情（包含关联数据）\n      const detailResponse = await axios.get(\n        &#96;${this.tpdApiBaseUrl}/tech-points/${tpdTechPoint.id}&#96;,\n        {\n          params: {\n            includeAssociations: true,\n          },\n          timeout: 30000,\n        }\n      );\n\n      if (detailResponse.data.code !== 200 || !detailResponse.data.data) {\n        throw new Error('获取技术点详情失败');\n      }\n\n      const techPointDetail = detailResponse.data.data;\n\n      // 准备技术点数据\n      const techPointData: CreateTechPointDTO = {\n        name: techPointDetail.name,\n        description: techPointDetail.description || null,\n        category_id: techPointDetail.category_id || null,\n        parent_id: techPointDetail.parent_id || null,\n        level: techPointDetail.level || 1,\n        tech_type: this.mapTechType(techPointDetail.tech_type),\n        priority: this.mapPriority(techPointDetail.priority),\n        status: this.mapStatus(techPointDetail.status),\n        tags: techPointDetail.tags || null,\n        technical_details: techPointDetail.technical_details || null,\n        benefits: techPointDetail.benefits || null,\n        applications: techPointDetail.applications || null,\n        keywords: techPointDetail.keywords || null,\n        source_url: techPointDetail.source_url || null,\n        created_by: techPointDetail.created_by || null,\n      };\n\n      // 检查技术点是否已存在（通过名称查找，因为 ID 可能不同）\n      // 首先尝试通过 ID 查找\n      let existing = await techPointModel.findById(techPointDetail.id);\n      \n      // 如果通过 ID 找不到，尝试通过名称查找\n      if (!existing) {\n        const allTechPoints = await techPointModel.findAll({ limit: 10000 });\n        existing = allTechPoints.data.find((tp: any) =&gt; tp.name === techPointDetail.name);\n      }\n\n      let created = false;\n      if (existing) {\n        // 更新现有技术点\n        const updateData: UpdateTechPointDTO = techPointData;\n        await techPointModel.update(existing.id, updateData);\n        created = false;\n      } else {\n        // 创建新技术点\n        await techPointModel.create(techPointData);\n        created = true;\n      }\n\n      // 同步关联的车型（如果有）\n      if (techPointDetail.carModels &amp;&amp; Array.isArray(techPointDetail.carModels)) {\n        // 这里可以添加同步车型关联的逻辑\n        // 由于车型关联可能涉及复杂的业务逻辑，暂时跳过\n        logger.debug(&#96;技术点 ${techPointDetail.id} 关联了 ${techPointDetail.carModels.length} 个车型&#96;);\n      }\n\n      return { created };\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.error(&#96;同步技术点 ${tpdTechPoint.id} 失败:&#96;, error);\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 映射技术点类型\n   */\n  private mapTechType(tpdType: string): TechType {\n    const typeMap: Record&lt;string, TechType&gt; = {\n      feature: TechType.FEATURE,\n      technology: TechType.TECHNOLOGY,\n      innovation: TechType.INNOVATION,\n      improvement: TechType.IMPROVEMENT,\n    };\n    return typeMap[tpdType] || TechType.FEATURE;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 映射优先级\n   */\n  private mapPriority(tpdPriority: string): Priority {\n    const priorityMap: Record&lt;string, Priority&gt; = {\n      low: Priority.LOW,\n      medium: Priority.MEDIUM,\n      high: Priority.HIGH,\n      critical: Priority.CRITICAL,\n    };\n    return priorityMap[tpdPriority] || Priority.MEDIUM;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 映射状态\n   */\n  private mapStatus(tpdStatus: string): Status {\n    const statusMap: Record&lt;string, Status&gt; = {\n      active: Status.ACTIVE,\n      inactive: Status.INACTIVE,\n      draft: Status.DRAFT,\n      archived: Status.ARCHIVED,\n    };\n    return statusMap[tpdStatus] || Status.DRAFT;\n  }\n}\n\n// 导出单例实例\nexport const tpdSyncService = new TPDSyncService();\n\n",
  "totalLinesInFile": 241
}

        "contents": "export class CarModelModel {\nasync findAll(options: FindAllCarModelsOptions = {}): Promise&lt;{ carModels: CarModel[]; total: number }&gt; {\nlet sql = &#96;\n\n      LIMIT ? OFFSET ?\n    &#96;;\n    \n    if (includeBrand) {\n      sql = &#96;\n        SELECT \n          cm.*,\n          b.id as brand_id_ref,\n          b.name as brand_name,\n          b.name_en as brand_name_en\n        FROM car_models cm\n        LEFT JOIN brands b ON cm.brand_id = b.id\n        ${whereClause}\n        ORDER BY cm.${orderBy} ${orderDirection}\n        LIMIT ? OFFSET ?\n      &#96;;\n    }\n    \n    const params = [...whereParams, limit, offset];\n    \n    try {\n      const result = await this.db.query(sql, params);\n      const carModels = Array.isArray(result) ? result : result.rows || [];\n      \n      const processedCarModels = carModels.map((carModel: any) =&gt; {\n        if (includeBrand &amp;&amp; carModel.brand_name) {\n          return {\n            ...carModel,\n            brand: {\n              id: carModel.brand_id,\n              name: carModel.brand_name,\n              name_en: carModel.brand_name_en\n            }\n          };\n        }\n        return carModel;\n      });\n      \n      return {\n        carModels: processedCarModels as CarModel[],\n        total\n      };\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('查询车型列表失败:', error);\n      throw new Error('查询车型列表失败');\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 根据品牌ID查找车型\n   */\n  async findByBrandId(brandId: number, options: Omit&lt;FindAllCarModelsOptions, 'where'&gt; = {}): Promise&lt;{ carModels: CarModel[]; total: number }&gt; {\n    \n  }\n}",

        "contents": "### 3. 车系表 (car_series)\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\nCREATE TABLE car_series (\n  id INT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,\n  model_id INT NOT NULL,\n  name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT '车系名称',\n  name_en VARCHAR(100) COMMENT '英文名称',\n  generation VARCHAR(50) COMMENT '世代信息',\n  launch_year INT COMMENT '上市年份',\n  end_year INT COMMENT '停产年份',\n  market_segment ENUM('economy', 'compact', 'mid-size', 'full-size', 'luxury', 'sport', 'premium') COMMENT '市场定位',\n  body_style VARCHAR(100) COMMENT '车身样式',\n  engine_types JSON COMMENT '发动机类型',\n  fuel_types JSON COMMENT '燃料类型',\n  description TEXT COMMENT '车系描述',\n  metadata JSON COMMENT '额外信息',\n  status ENUM('active', 'discontinued', 'planned') DEFAULT 'active',\n  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n  updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n  FOREIGN KEY (model_id) REFERENCES car_models(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n  INDEX idx_model_id (model_id),\n  INDEX idx_status (status),\n  INDEX idx_market_segment (market_segment)\n);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## 数据示例\n\n### 品牌数据\n- 奥迪 (Audi)\n- 宝马 (BMW)\n- 奔驰 (Mercedes-Benz)\n\n### 车型数据\n- 奥迪 A 系列\n- 奥迪 Q 系列\n- 宝马 1 系列\n- 宝马 3 系列\n- 宝马 X 系列\n\n### 车系数据\n- 奥迪 A 系列 -&gt; A3, A4, A6, A8\n- 奥迪 Q 系列 -&gt; Q3, Q5, Q7, Q8\n- 宝马 3 系列 -&gt; 3系轿车, 3系旅行车, 3系GT\n\n## API 接口设计\n\n### 品牌相关接口\n- GET /api/v1/brands - 获取品牌列表\n- POST /api/v1/brands - 创建品牌\n- PUT /api/v1/brands/:id - 更新品牌\n- DELETE /api/v1/brands/:id - 删除品牌\n\n### 车型相关接口\n- GET /api/v1/models - 获取车型列表\n- GET /api/v1/brands/:brandId/models - 获取指定品牌的车型\n- POST /api/v1/models - 创建车型\n- PUT /api/v1/models/:id - 更新车型\n- DELETE /api/v1/models/:id - 删除车型\n\n### 车系相关接口\n- GET /api/v1/series - 获取车系列表\n- GET /api/v1/models/:modelId/series - 获取指定车型的车系\n- POST /api/v1/series - 创建车系\n- PUT /api/v1/series/:id - 更新车系",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "### 3. 车系表 (car_series)",

          {

        "contents": "export class TechPointModel {\nasync getAssociatedContent(techPointId: number): Promise&lt;{\n    packagingMaterials: any[];\n    promotionStrategies: any[];\n    pressReleases: any[];\n    speeches: any[];\n  }&gt; {\n\n\n    try {\n    // 获取演讲稿\n    const speechSql = &#96;\n      SELECT sp.*, st.weight \n      FROM tech_speeches sp\n      JOIN speech_tech_points st ON sp.id = st.speech_id\n      WHERE st.tech_point_id = ?\n      ORDER BY sp.created_at DESC\n    &#96;;\n      try {\n        const speechResult = await this.db.query(speechSql, [techPointId]);\n        result.speeches = Array.isArray(speechResult) ? speechResult : [];\n      } catch (error: any) {\n        if (!error.message?.includes('no such table')) {\n          console.warn('获取演讲稿失败:', error.message);\n        }\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      // 忽略错误\n    }\n\n    return result;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 获取技术点关联的车型\n   */\n  async getAssociatedCarModels(techPointId: number): Promise&lt;any[]&gt; {\n    try {\n    const sql = &#96;\n        SELECT \n          cm.*,\n          b.id as brand_id_ref,\n          b.name as brand_name,\n          b.name_en as brand_name_en,\n          tcm.application_status, \n          tcm.implementation_date, \n          tcm.notes\n      FROM car_models cm\n        LEFT JOIN brands b ON cm.brand_id = b.id\n      JOIN tech_point_car_models tcm ON cm.id = tcm.car_model_id\n      WHERE tcm.tech_point_id = ?\n        ORDER BY COALESCE(b.name, ''), cm.name\n    &#96;;\n    \n      const result = await this.db.query(sql, [techPointId]);\n      const carModels = Array.isArray(result) ? result : [];\n      \n      // 调试日志：检查返回的数据\n      if (carModels.length &gt; 0) {\n        console.log(&#96;[TechPointModel] 获取技术点 ${techPointId} 的关联车型:&#96;, \n          carModels.map((cm: any) =&gt; ({\n            id: cm.id,\n            name: cm.name\n)\n\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "/**\n * 查找或创建车型\n */\nasync function findOrCreateCarModel(\n  brandName: string,\n  carModelName: string,\n  type?: string\n): Promise&lt;number&gt; {\n  // 验证输入\n  if (!brandName || brandName.trim() === '') {\n    throw new Error('品牌名称不能为空');\n  }\n  if (!carModelName || carModelName.trim() === '') {\n    throw new Error('车型名称不能为空');\n  }\n  \n  const trimmedBrandName = brandName.trim();\n  const trimmedCarModelName = carModelName.trim();\n  \n  // 先查找或创建品牌\n  const brandId = await findOrCreateBrand(trimmedBrandName);\n\n  // 查找车型\n  const carModelSql = 'SELECT id FROM car_models WHERE brand_id = ? AND name = ?';\n  const carModelResult = await db.query(carModelSql, [brandId, trimmedCarModelName]);\n  \n  if (Array.isArray(carModelResult) &amp;&amp; carModelResult.length &gt; 0) {\n    return carModelResult[0].id;\n  }\n\n  // 创建车型\n  const categoryMap: Record&lt;string, string&gt; = {\n    '轿车': 'sedan',\n    'SUV': 'suv',\n    'MPV': 'mpv',\n    '跑车': 'coupe',\n    '皮卡': 'pickup',\n  };\n  \n  const category = type ? categoryMap[type] || null : null;\n  \n  const insertCarModelSql = &#96;\n    INSERT INTO car_models (brand_id, name, category, status) \n    VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)\n  &#96;;\n  const insertResult = await db.query(insertCarModelSql, [\n    brandId,\n    trimmedCarModelName,\n    category,\n    'active'\n  ]);\n  const carModelId = insertResult.lastID || insertResult.insertId;\n  console.log(&#96;  ✅ 创建车型: ${trimmedBrandName} ${trimmedCarModelName} (ID: ${carModelId})&#96;);\n  return carModelId;\n}\n\n/**\n * 导入单个技术点\n */\nasync function importTechPoint(tpdTechPoint: TPD2TechPoint): Promise&lt;{\n  success: boolean;\n  techPointId?: number;\n  message: string;\n}&gt; {\n  \n}",

        "contents": "export const useCarModels = () =&gt; {\n  const [carModels, setCarModels] = useState&lt;CarModel[]&gt;([]);\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);\n  const [error, setError] = useState&lt;string | null&gt;(null);\n\n  const fetchCarModels = useCallback(async () =&gt; {\n    setLoading(true);\n    setError(null);\n    \n    try {\n      const response = await techPointService.getCarModels();\n      if (response.success &amp;&amp; response.data) {\n        setCarModels(response.data);\n      } else {\n        setError(response.error || '获取车型列表失败');\n      }\n    } catch (err) {\n      setError('获取车型列表失败');\n    } finally {\n      setLoading(false);\n    }\n  }, []);\n\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    fetchCarModels();\n  }, [fetchCarModels]);\n\n  return {\n    carModels,\n    loading,\n    error,\n    fetchCarModels\n  };\n};",

        "contents": "export class CarModelModel {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 查找所有车型\n   */\n  async findAll(options: FindAllCarModelsOptions = {}): Promise&lt;{ carModels: CarModel[]; total: number }&gt; {\n    await this.ensureConnection();\n    \n    const {\n      limit = 50,\n      offset = 0,\n      orderBy = 'created_at',\n      orderDirection = 'DESC',\n      includeBrand = true\n    } = options;\n\n    // 构建WHERE条件\n    let whereClause = '';\n    let whereParams: any[] = [];\n    \n    if (options.where) {\n      const conditions: string[] = [];\n      \n      if (options.where.name) {\n        conditions.push('cm.name LIKE ?');\n        whereParams.push(&#96;%${options.where.name}%&#96;);\n      }\n      \n      if (options.where.brand_id) {\n        conditions.push('cm.brand_id = ?');\n        whereParams.push(options.where.brand_id);\n      }\n      \n      if (options.where.status) {\n        conditions.push('cm.status = ?');\n        whereParams.push(options.where.status);\n      }\n      \n      if (options.where.category) {\n        conditions.push('cm.category = ?');\n        whereParams.push(options.where.category);\n      }\n      \n      if (options.where.launch_year) {\n        conditions.push('cm.launch_year = ?');\n        whereParams.push(options.where.launch_year);\n      }\n      \n      if (conditions.length &gt; 0) {\n        whereClause = 'WHERE ' + conditions.join(' AND ');\n      }\n    }\n\n    // 查询总数\n    const countSql = &#96;SELECT COUNT(*) as total FROM car_models cm ${whereClause}&#96;;\n    const countResult = await this.db.query(countSql, whereParams);\n    const total = Array.isArray(countResult) ? countResult[0].total : countResult.total;\n\n    // 查询数据\n    let sql = &#96;\n      SELECT cm.* FROM car_models cm\n      ${whereClause}\n      ORDER BY cm.${orderBy} ${orderDirection}\n      LIMIT ? OFFSET ?\n    &#96;;\n    \n    if (includeBrand)\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class CarModelModel {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 根据ID查找车型\n   */\n  async findById(id: number, includeBrand: boolean = true): Promise&lt;CarModel&gt; {\n    await this.ensureConnection();\n    \n    let sql = 'SELECT * FROM car_models WHERE id = ?';\n    \n    if (includeBrand) {\n      sql = &#96;\n        SELECT \n          cm.*,\n          b.id as brand_id_ref,\n          b.name as brand_name,\n          b.name_en as brand_name_en\n        FROM car_models cm\n        LEFT JOIN brands b ON cm.brand_id = b.id\n        WHERE cm.id = ?\n      &#96;;\n    }\n    \n    try {\n      const result = await this.db.query(sql, [id]);\n      const carModels = Array.isArray(result) ? result : result.rows || [result];\n      \n      if (carModels.length === 0) {\n        throw new Error('车型不存在');\n      }\n      \n      const carModel = carModels[0] as any;\n      \n      if (includeBrand &amp;&amp; carModel.brand_name) {\n        return {\n          ...carModel,\n          brand: {\n            id: carModel.brand_id,\n            name: carModel.brand_name,\n            name_en: carModel.brand_name_en\n          }\n        } as CarModel;\n      }\n      \n      return carModel as CarModel;\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('查找车型失败:', error);\n      throw new Error('查找车型失败');\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 查找所有车型\n   */\n  async findAll(options: FindAllCarModelsOptions = {}): Promise&lt;{ carModels: CarModel[]; total: number }&gt; {\n    \n  }\n}",

## 完成的工作

### 1. 数据库迁移
- 创建迁移脚本：`003_add_tpd_fields_to_tech_points.sql` 和 `.ts`
- 添加字段：
  - `tpd_id`: TPD2 项目 ID（同步锚点）
  - `car_models_info`: JSON 格式存储车型信息
  - `resources_info`: JSON 格式存储资源信息
  - `knowledge_info`: JSON 格式存储知识点详情

### 2. 后端模型更新
- 更新 `TechPointModel` 的 `create()` 和 `update()` 方法，支持新 JSON 字段
- 更新 `parseJsonFields()` 方法，自动解析新的 JSON 字段
- 更新类型定义，添加 `CarModelInfo`、`ResourceInfo`、`KnowledgeInfo` 接口

### 3. 同步服务重构
- 更新 `TPDSyncService`，将 TPD2 API 返回的车型数据转换为 `CarModelInfo[]` 格式
